title: Plan release provenance publication
summary: Public provenance can verify local envelopes, but release artifacts still need key-custody policy, artifact subject binding, and transparency-publication gates before public provenance claims.
expectedFailureModes: Release provenance claims are made without a public key custody decision.
Artifact subjects are not bound to file digests and validation evidence.
Transparency publication is implied before a verifiable publication target exists.
humanEscalation: Human approval is required before publishing public keys, release signatures, or transparency-log entries.
nextAction: Add release-provenance readiness output that checks artifact subject metadata and key-custody placeholders without publishing transparency entries.
